mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item ( order_id, sku_id, product_name, option_summary, quantity, unit_price, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{optionSummary}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.option_summary AS optionSummary, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS lineAmount, oi.supplier_status AS status, oi.carrier AS carrier, oi.tracking_no AS trackingNo, ( SELECT pi.image_path FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbPath FROM order_item oi JOIN sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.order_id AS orderId, o.created_at AS orderedAt, o.user_id AS buyerId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.option_summary AS optionSummary, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.supplier_status AS supplierStatus, oi.carrier AS carrier, oi.tracking_no AS trackingNo, o.status AS orderStatus FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND p.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_item oi JOIN sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id SET oi.carrier = #{carrier}, oi.tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, oi.supplier_status = #{status} WHERE oi.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND p.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
